artworks.title: Little Shelter (Le petit hangar)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.description: This is an etching of a rustic scene. A thatched-roof building is on the left side, surrounded by trees. A figure is shown near the structure. The horizon line is visible beyond the trees, with hills and a distant town in the background. The technique uses fine lines and cross-hatching to create texture and depth. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of sepia.

artworks.title: Return of the Fagot-gatherer, 2nd plate (Le retour du fagotier)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills. The horizon is high in the image, showcasing a small, rustic house partially hidden by trees. The scene is depicted with textured brushstrokes, mainly in the foliage and figure. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and sepia. In the foreground, a figure is carrying a bundle of sticks along a path.

artworks.title: Sunset (Le soir (Coucher de soleil))
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching?
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated view, featuring trees clustered on the right side. The horizon is low and obscured by dense trees. The trees vary in height, with wild and natural growth. The brushstrokes are fine, with cross-hatching in the sky for texture. The color palette is monochrome with black and white shades for contrast. A still body of water reflects the dark scene. The terrain texture suggests movement, and the sky has a network of lines.

artworks.title: The Cooper (Le tonnelier)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image features a scene with a slightly elevated, three-quarter angle viewpoint. It includes a thatched-roof building, a smaller stone structure with a doorway, a man working near barrels, and a horse standing to the left. The background shows tree tops, but the horizon is not clearly visible. The scene is depicted with fine lines, creating depth and movement. The color scheme is monochromatic, with various shades of brown and sepia. The composition conveys a rustic, tranquil atmosphere with rural elements like logs, barrels, and simple structures set in a textured landscape.

artworks.title: Pigeon Tower (La tour aux pigeons)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.description: The image features a landscape portrayed from a slightly elevated perspective. Various elements such as trees, a cylindrical tower, a tiled roof structure, and dense vegetation are depicted with meticulous brushstrokes using an etching technique. The scene is dominated by a monochromatic color palette of grays, blacks, and off-whites. Diagonal lines on the ground suggest a slope leading towards the distant structures and natural elements.

artworks.title: Pigeon Tower (La tour aux pigeons)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.description: The image shows a rural setting with various structures and natural elements. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. A round stone structure is prominently featured towards the center right. Detailed cross-hatched etching is used throughout, especially in the foliage and rooftops. A narrow path leads towards the structures, with stone walls and trees alongside. The color scheme is mainly black and grey. Additional trees can be seen in the distance on the right side.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son, 2nd plate (L'enfant prodigue)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with undulating terrain and a dense backdrop of thickets and trees blending into the horizon. A figure is kneeling to the left, possibly writing on the ground with a stick. Trees dominate the left side, with their trunks extending into the foliage. The artist uses fine lines to create textures and forms. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of sepia.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.creditLine: Gift in honor of Lessing J. Rosenwald and Elizabeth Mongan by William and Frederick Schab
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a crucifixion scene with three figures. The central figure is a man crucified on a cross, accompanied by two other figures with circular halos above their heads. The style of the drawing is linear and woodcut-like, with bold outlines and minimal detailing. The background is plain, and the drawing is monochromatic with subtle color washes.

artworks.title: Winter Scene
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a winter scene with a snow-covered path flanked by trees and houses in the distance. A figure with a child and a dog walks along the path, while a horse-drawn cart moves towards the center. The sky is overcast with various shades of gray. The painting features detailed brushstrokes and a muted color palette of whites, grays, and browns, capturing a serene winter day.

artworks.title: Ballet Scene
artworks.medium: pastel on greenish transparent tracing paper
artworks.description: Six pink-skinned ballerinas stretch of practice in this horizontal pastel drawing. The scene is roughly sketched so some details, like the women’s faces, are indistinct. They all have brown hair and costumes with sleeveless bodices and knee-length tutus. Three dancers cluster close to us. Two at the front have tutus shaded with peacock blue and amethyst purple and dotted with spring green. The bodices of these two and the one standing behind them are copper orange. The woman to our right holds both hands to the small of her back. Another touches her hair with both hands, and the third stands with her feet apart in fourth position, toes pointing outward, and hands clasped gracefully down in front of her. The other three dancers wear pale pink bodices and tutus that match the color of their skin. Taking up the left half of the composition and moving slightly back in space, one dancer leans forward with one arm raised, and the other two bend double to brush one hand by their feet. The floor is tawny brown. The background is loosely drawn with strokes of lime green, pale pink, teal blue, and sand brown. The artist’s name appeared in the lower left corner, “Degas.”

artworks.title: Jane Avril
artworks.medium: oil on cardboard mounted on wood

artworks.title: La Goulue and Her Sister
artworks.medium: oil à l'essence on gelatin silver print mounted on board

artworks.title: Caroline Rémy ("Séverine")
artworks.medium: pastel on paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 62.3 x 50.8 cm (24 1/2 x 20 in.)
framed: 86.3 x 76.2 cm (34 x 30 in.)
artworks.description: Shown from the waist up in front a yellow background sits a pale-skinned woman wearing a high-necked, long-sleeved blue dress in this vertical pastel. The woman leans slightly to our left as that elbow rests on the arm of a chair or other piece of furniture. She has large blue eyes under dark brows, a round face, and her pink lips are parted to reveal a row of white teeth. Brown tousled curls create bangs across her forehead, and her hair is pulled back under a black and white cap perched on the back of her head. A blue-black ribbon ties in a bow to the right under her chin. Coral-peach, yellow, and pale green flowers cascade from her left shoulder, to our right, down to the chest of her light blue, long-sleeved bodice. The cuff we see is shaded green, and she wears a bracelet and ring on that wrist and hand. Her other arm appears to reach slightly forward and presumably rest in her lap. The woman and the bright yellow background are created with blended strokes, giving the pastel a soft look. The artist signed the lower left corner in cobalt blue, “Renoir.”

artworks.title: Mother and Baby
artworks.medium: crayon and pen and black ink with gray and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a side profile, holding an infant in her arms. She has long, dark hair and is wearing a long, flowing dress. The baby is wrapped in a blanket. A shadow is cast on the wall next to them. The background is plain and textured.

artworks.title: Prosecutor
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of a person's body, from the chest upwards. The individual is either standing or seated facing forward, slightly turned to their left. The person's face is partially obscured by shadows, emphasizing their nose and cheekbones. They wear a dark headpiece and a long robe with a light vertical strip down the chest. No accessories or objects are visible. The background is a plain, dark, brownish tone, contrasting the subject.

artworks.title: Two Lawyers
artworks.medium: charcoal and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing together. Both are depicted from head to toe, facing slightly to the right. They have rough facial sketches and appear older. They both have short hair covered by a dark, cap-like headdress and are wearing long, dark robes. One person's arms are crossed, while the other seems to be holding their robe. In the background, there are blurred outlines of other figures.

artworks.title: Jean Louis Gampert
artworks.medium: black crayon, graphite and watercolor
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person depicted from the waist up. The person is seated and is holding a book in their left hand, which is raised. Their right arm appears to be resting across their body. The individual has short, neatly combed hair and features that are rendered with strong lines, including prominent eyebrows and a defined nose, with a subtle smile on their lips. They are dressed in a dark garment. The background includes a wooden structure to the person's right and an abstract shape to their left, against a bluish-green wall. The illustration gives an impression of a cozy, intellectual setting.

artworks.title: The Bath
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: A woman kneels to test the water in a freestanding bathtub with one hand as she braces a nude child against her knee with the other in this vertical, colored print. The people and objects are outlined lightly with brown for the bodies and black for the woman’s clothing. Both the woman and baby’s hair are incised with delicate black lines. The woman’s hair is pulled back from a high forehead, and she has a straight nose, pursed lips, and a slight double chin. Her long-sleeved, floor-length dress has a narrow collar and is pleated across the chest and at the cuff we can see. The dress is filled in with a field of bright lemon yellow and patterned with a floral design. The baby turns toward the woman’s body and hangs their arms over her bracing hand. The baby has short, wispy, black hair with delicate facial features, a rotund belly, and satisfyingly pudgy rolls on the legs. The tub is denim blue, and the water within a paler shade. There are some smudges across the paper, especially at the edges. A mark with an oval, or a mirrored C, over an uppercase M, is stamped in royal blue at the bottom center of the print. The sheet is inscribed with graphite across the right half of the bottom margin. Text reads, “Edition de 25 épreuves Imprimée par l’artiste et M. Leroy Mary Cassatt."

artworks.title: The Lamp
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a young woman seated from the waist up. She has brown hair, soft facial features, and wears a light blue dress. A fabric fan is near her elbow. The background features a blue lamp with a pink shade on a table, along with a teacup and milk jug. The setting is a vibrant, pastel-colored room with decorative walls.

artworks.title: In the Omnibus
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: Two women, one holding a baby on her lap, sit on the long bench seat of an omnibus in this vertical, colored print. The women and their full skirts take up almost the width of the composition against the peacock-blue bench, which extends off both sides. The women and baby’s skin are the color of the cream-white paper. The woman to our left wears a tan-colored, high-collared dress, gloves, and hat. She looks off to our right, almost in profile. She has a round face and the hint of a double chin. One gloved hand rests on a cane. The other woman holds the baby and tips her head down toward the child. That second woman wears a tea rose-pink dress and a hat with areas of darker pink, fern green, and straw yellow. Both women’s black hair is pulled up under their hats. The baby’s ruffled white bonnet, blousy garment, stockings, and shoes are also the white of the paper, though the hair is picked out with yellow, the lips with pink, and the ball held in one hand with brown. The structure of the women’s bodices, puffy long sleeves, and long skirts as well as the baby’s clothing are outlined in black. A row of windows behind them, parallel to the top of the bench, open onto an arched bridge spanning a river with boats. To our left, the sandy water’s edge is lined with spruce green trees. Back inside, the panel behind the women’s legs is peanut brown, and the top of the omnibus is muted mauve purple. A mark with an oval, or a mirrored C, over an uppercase M, is stamped in royal blue at the bottom center of the print. The sheet is inscribed with graphite across the right half of the bottom margin. Text reads, “Edition de 25 épreuves Imprimée par l’artiste et M. Leroy Mary Cassatt."

artworks.title: The Letter
artworks.medium: color softground etching, drypoint and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: We look slightly down onto a young woman sitting at a writing desk as she licks an envelope in this vertical, color print. A table folds down or extends from a tall secretary desk to our right. The blotter on the table and the woman’s long dress are both royal blue. The dress has a vaguely floral pattern in tan, and the jacket is open to reveal a vertically pleated, beige-pink shirt beneath. The woman’s skin is faintly tinted almost yellow. Her black hair is pulled back over dark brows and a delicate nose. She holds the open flap of the envelope to her mouth with both hands. A piece of white paper lies on the desktop in front of her. She sits in a brown chair, and the wallpaper of the room is patterned with green and muted brown flowers against a white background. The sheet is inscribed with graphite across the right half of the bottom margin, “Edition de 25 épreuves Imprimée par l'artiste et M. Leroy Mary Cassatt.”

artworks.title: The Fitting
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three women from the waist up. The central woman is facing slightly to the side, with short, dark hair and a calm expression. She wears a long, striped dress with puffy sleeves. Next to her, another woman is seen from the back, looking into a mirror, dressed similarly. Below them, another woman's head is visible, turned away, wearing dark clothing with stripes. The background includes a patterned wallpaper with floral motifs and a decorative carpet.

artworks.title: Woman Bathing
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: A pale-skinned woman bends over a basin of water on a washstand in this vertical, colored print. The woman is angled away from us so only her ear and the curve of her forehead are visible beyond her hunched shoulder. Her upper body is bare, her dress having been unfastened so it hangs around her waist. The dress is striped with grass green, rose pink, and the cream white of the paper. Light gleams on her auburn hair, which is tied up and back. She cups her hands in the light blue water of the faintly yellow basin. Two bottles sit at the back corner of the washstand, and a mirror reflects the top of her head. The fawn-brown washstand is boxy, and a handled white pitcher painted with muted pink flowers is at the front left corner, which is closest to us. The wall beyond the washstand is sapphire blue, as is the carpet, which is also patterned with celery-green leaves. A mark with an oval, or a mirrored C, over an uppercase M, is stamped in royal blue at the bottom center of the print. The sheet is inscribed with graphite across the right half of the bottom margin, “Imprimée par l'artiste et M. Leroy Mary Cassatt.”
